checks.evidence: cargo fmt --all -- --check and CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true cargo test --workspace --locked --offline; all workspace tests passed, including the explicit non-loopback listen opt-in test
WSL initiated a linux/amd64 Docker build with Rust, CPython, Node, uv, Python and npm dependencies pinned or locked
container health became healthy; Core status and doctor returned passed with both Hosts active and restart_count 0
Docker inspect showed 127.0.0.1:26789 mapped to container port 26701; a WSL client received HTTP 200 from /v1/status
Koishi-only run activated Koishi and left NoneBot disabled with no PID; NoneBot-only run activated NoneBot and left Koishi disabled with no PID
published HTTP API invoked both Host math capabilities with result 42; valid OneBot v11 numeric-ID events were accepted and completed on both Hosts
the Core SQLite database existed in /var/lib/ligamina; a marker under the Koishi data directory and the SQLite file remained after Compose down/up with the named volume retained

inspect showed a read-only root filesystem, cap_drop ALL, read-only daemon config, and no Docker socket mount; Compose down stopped and removed the container while retaining the volume; the temporary test volume and test credentials were then removed

implementation_findings_fixed: Added a default-false allow_non_loopback_listen setting; container entrypoint opts in because Docker bridge forwarding needs a container-interface listener, while Compose publishes only on host loopback.
Copied contracts/v0.1 into the runtime image because both Workers read the shared schemas at startup.
Moved the pinned NoneBot FastAPI driver extra into production dependencies so the locked runtime can start its selected driver.
Added a valid unconnected example Gateway registration so Core startup validation passes without granting platform operations.
limitations: The example Gateway is unconnected and has no operation grants; no real chat platform send or receipt was exercised.

The container ran on Docker Desktop's desktop-linux engine because Docker integration is disabled inside the WSL distribution. The build and Linux-side validation commands were initiated from local WSL.
This T16 result does not close G2. T13's complete WSL third-party matrix, T14's 24-hour resource run, full T15 clean-VM acceptance, T17 CI, and T18 final acceptance remain open.
